description: Search ReliefWeb humanitarian reports, disasters, jobs, training, and country profiles via MCP.

tool_signatures.name: reliefweb_get_country
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a country profile from ReliefWeb by ISO3 code, including overview, humanitarian situation summary, key content links, active appeals and response plans, and useful external links. Country profiles are curated by OCHA editors and provide the authoritative situation summary for humanitarian responders.

iso3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., SYR, AFG, UKR). Used to look up the country's ReliefWeb profile.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this country page.

keyContent.description: Curated key content links maintained by ReliefWeb editors.

usefulLinks.description: Useful external links curated by ReliefWeb editors.

profileOverview.description: Situation overview text from the ReliefWeb editorial team.

items.description: An appeal or response plan entry.

appealsResponsePlans.description: Active humanitarian appeals and response plans for this country.

tool_signatures.name: reliefweb_get_disaster
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a disaster record by ReliefWeb numeric ID including description, affected countries, GLIDE number, profile overview, key content links, and active appeals or response plans. Use after reliefweb_search_disasters to retrieve full details.

id.description: ReliefWeb numeric disaster ID. Obtained from reliefweb_search_disasters results.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this disaster.

countries.description: All countries tagged on this disaster.

keyContent.description: Curated key content links from the ReliefWeb editorial team.

usefulLinks.description: Useful external links curated by ReliefWeb editors.

profileOverview.description: Profile overview text from the ReliefWeb editorial team.

items.description: An appeal or response plan entry.

appealsResponsePlans.description: Active appeals and response plans linked to this disaster.

tool_signatures.name: reliefweb_get_report
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a single ReliefWeb report by its numeric ID with full body text, file attachments, and all metadata. Use after reliefweb_search_reports to retrieve document content — body is excluded from search results to manage context budget. Report bodies can be 10–100KB; call this only when you need the full document text.

id.description: ReliefWeb numeric report ID. Obtained from reliefweb_search_reports results.

body.description: Full report body text (HTML). Present for most reports; absent for binary-only documents.

fileUrls.description: Direct file download URLs attached to this report.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this report.

countries.description: All countries tagged on this report.

primaryCountry.description: Primary country name for this report.

headlineSummary.description: Short editorial summary from the headline block, when present.

tool_signatures.name: reliefweb_list_countries
tool_signatures.description: List all countries and territories tracked by ReliefWeb, optionally filtered to active humanitarian situations. Returns ISO3 codes and status for each entry — use the ISO3 code with reliefweb_get_country to fetch a full profile. Set crisis_only=true to limit results to countries with active humanitarian situations.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–1000, default 100). Each call counts against the 1,000-calls/day quota.

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Use with limit and the totalCount enrichment field to page through results.

crisis_only.description: When true, filters to countries with an active humanitarian situation (status alert or current). Default false returns all countries.

iso3.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code for use with reliefweb_get_country.

status.description: Humanitarian situation status. Active situations have status alert or current.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this country page.

items.description: A country or territory tracked by ReliefWeb.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — echoes the active filter and suggests how to broaden. Absent on successful result pages.

totalCount.description: Total countries matching the filter before pagination.

tool_signatures.name: reliefweb_list_sources
tool_signatures.description: Browse source organizations that contribute content to ReliefWeb, optionally filtered by name text or organization type. Returns short names, types, and URLs. Use the shortname value with the source filter in reliefweb_search_reports, reliefweb_search_jobs, and reliefweb_search_training.

text.description: Full-text search query. Matches against organization name and short name.

type.description: Organization type. Must match exact API values: "Government", "International Organization", "Non-governmental Organization", "Academia", "United Nations", "Other". Filters on type.name.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–1000, default 10). Each call counts against the 1,000-calls/day quota.

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Use with limit and the totalCount enrichment field to page through results.

shortname.description: Organization short name — use this value in the source filter for other search tools.

items.description: A source organization contributing content to ReliefWeb.
Source organizations contributing content to ReliefWeb.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — echoes the active filters and suggests how to broaden. Absent on successful result pages.

totalCount.description: Total sources matching the query before pagination.

tool_signatures.name: reliefweb_search_disasters
tool_signatures.description: Search active and historical disasters on ReliefWeb by type, country, status, date range, and GLIDE number. Default preset covers alert, current, and past disasters. Use include_archived=true to include alert-archive and archive entries for historical research. Returns IDs suitable for use with reliefweb_get_disaster and as disaster_id filter in reliefweb_search_reports.

sort.description: Sort order. Use date.created:desc for newest first (default), date.created:asc for oldest, score:desc for relevance.

text.description: Full-text search query. Matches against disaster name and description.

glide.description: GLIDE number (global disaster identifier, e.g., EQ-2023-000053-TUR). Use for cross-system disaster correlation.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–1000, default 10). Each call counts against the 1,000-calls/day quota.

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Use with limit and the totalCount enrichment field to page through results.

status.description: Disaster status filter. Values: alert (newly declared), current (ongoing), past (resolved), alert-archive, archive. Separate multiple values with commas. Default preset includes alert, current, past.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., SYR, AFG, UKR). Filters to disasters tagged with this primary country.

date_to.description: Latest disaster creation date (ISO 8601). Pair with date_from for a date range.

date_from.description: Earliest disaster creation date (ISO 8601). Filters on date.created.

disaster_type.description: Disaster type name (e.g., Earthquake, Flood, Drought, Cyclone). Filters on type.name.

include_archived.description: Include alert-archive and archive disasters in results. Uses preset=analysis. Off by default.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this disaster.

countries.description: All countries tagged on this disaster.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — echoes filters applied and suggests how to broaden.

totalCount.description: Total disasters matching the query before pagination.

sort.description: Sort order the query used (resolved, including the default).

preset.description: ReliefWeb preset the query used: latest (default) or analysis when include_archived.

appliedFilters.description: The resolved filter set the query actually ran with, after normalization and defaults. Echoes back so the agent can confirm how its inputs were interpreted.

tool_signatures.name: reliefweb_search_jobs
tool_signatures.description: Search humanitarian job listings on ReliefWeb by country, organization, career category, theme, and experience level. Returns current open positions — archived or expired jobs are excluded by default. Use text search for role titles and job descriptions.

text.description: Full-text search query. Matches against job title, body, and key metadata fields.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–1000, default 10). Each call counts against the 1,000-calls/day quota.

theme.description: Sector or cross-cutting theme (e.g., Health, Food and Nutrition, Protection). Filters on theme.name.

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Use with limit and the totalCount enrichment field to page through results.

source.description: Organization short name (e.g., UNHCR, OCHA, WFP). Filters on source.shortname.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., SYR, AFG, UKR). Filters to jobs tagged with this country.

experience.description: Experience level (e.g., 0-2 years, 3-4 years, 5-9 years). Filters on experience.name.

career_category.description: Humanitarian career track (e.g., Programme and Project Management, Information and Communications Technology, Logistics and Telecommunications). Filters on career_categories.name.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this job listing.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — echoes filters applied and suggests how to broaden.

totalCount.description: Total jobs matching the query before pagination.

sort.description: Sort order the query used (resolved, including the default).

appliedFilters.description: The resolved filter set the query actually ran with, after normalization and defaults. Echoes back so the agent can confirm how its inputs were interpreted.

tool_signatures.name: reliefweb_search_reports
tool_signatures.description: Search humanitarian reports on ReliefWeb with filtering by country, disaster, format, theme, language, source, and date. Returns paginated summaries — use reliefweb_get_report to fetch full body text. Report body is excluded from results (10–100KB each); call get_report when document content is needed. Use preset include_archived=true to include expired or archived reports in historical research. Note: each call counts against the 1,000 calls/day quota.

sort.description: Sort order. Use date.original:desc for newest first (default), date.original:asc for oldest first, score:desc for relevance.

text.description: Full-text search query. Matches against title, body, and key metadata fields. Use plain natural language or keywords.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–1000, default 10). Use a smaller value for targeted lookups; larger for bulk research. Each call counts against the 1,000-calls/day quota.

theme.description: Sector or cross-cutting theme (e.g., Health, Food and Nutrition, Shelter and NFI, Protection). Matches theme.name.

filter.description: Raw ReliefWeb filter object for compound conditions not covered by named params. Example: {"operator": "AND", "conditions": [{"field": "format.name", "value": "Map"}, {"field": "language.code", "value": "fr"}]}.

format.description: Content format filter. Valid values: Situation Report, Assessment, Analysis, Map, Infographic, Manual and Guideline, News and Press Release, Policy Document, Appeal, Financial Report, Evaluation and Lessons Learned, Other.

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Use with limit and the totalCount enrichment field to page through large result sets.

source.description: Organization short name (e.g., UNHCR, OCHA, WFP). Filters on source.shortname.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., SYR, AFG, UKR). Filters to content tagged with this country.

date_to.description: Latest publication date (ISO 8601). Pair with date_from for a date range.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code (e.g., en, fr, es, ar). Filters on language.code.

date_from.description: Earliest publication date (ISO 8601, e.g., 2024-01-15T00:00:00+00:00). Filters on date.original (source publication date).

disaster_id.description: ReliefWeb numeric disaster ID. Filters to reports linked to a specific disaster. Get the ID from reliefweb_search_disasters.

include_archived.description: Include archived and to-review content in addition to published. Uses preset=analysis. Off by default.

fileUrls.description: Direct file download URLs attached to this report.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this report.

countries.description: All countries tagged on this report.

primaryCountry.description: Primary country name for this report.

headlineSummary.description: Short editorial summary from the headline block, when present.

items.description: Matching reports (summaries only — use reliefweb_get_report for full body).

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — echoes the filters applied and suggests how to broaden. Absent on successful result pages.

totalCount.description: Total reports matching the query before pagination.

sort.description: Sort order the query used (resolved, including the default).

preset.description: ReliefWeb preset the query used: latest (default) or analysis when include_archived.

rawFilter.description: True when a raw compound filter object was merged into the query.

appliedFilters.description: The resolved filter set the query actually ran with, after normalization and defaults. Echoes back so the agent can confirm how its inputs were interpreted.

tool_signatures.name: reliefweb_search_training
tool_signatures.description: Search humanitarian training and learning opportunities on ReliefWeb by country, format, date, source, career category, and language. Covers workshops, e-learning, conferences, and other capacity-building events. Training date fields use date.start / date.end — different from report date fields. Use date_start_from and date_start_to to find upcoming training within a window.

text.description: Full-text search query. Matches against training title and description.

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–1000, default 10). Each call counts against the 1,000-calls/day quota.

format.description: Training format (e.g., Workshop, E-learning, Conference, Seminar). Filters on format.name.

offset.description: Zero-based offset for pagination. Use with limit and the totalCount enrichment field to page through results.

source.description: Organization short name. Filters on source.shortname.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., KEN, ETH, COD). Filters to training tagged with this country.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code (e.g., en, fr, es). Filters on language.code.

date_start_to.description: Training start date upper bound (ISO 8601). Filters on date.start — pair with date_start_from for a window.

career_category.description: Humanitarian career track (e.g., Programme and Project Management, Information and Communications Technology). Filters on career_categories.name.

date_start_from.description: Training start date lower bound (ISO 8601). Filters on date.start — use to find training starting after a given date.

urlAlias.description: Canonical ReliefWeb URL for this training listing.

notice.description: Recovery hint when results are empty — echoes filters applied and suggests how to broaden.

totalCount.description: Total training listings matching the query before pagination.

sort.description: Sort order the query used (resolved, including the default).

dateStartTo.description: Training start date upper bound applied.

dateStartFrom.description: Training start date lower bound applied.

appliedFilters.description: The resolved filter set the query actually ran with, after normalization and defaults. Echoes back so the agent can confirm how its inputs were interpreted.
